_note: Area edits. 'map_log2' = LoG2 map record (slice offset of M) imported with tools/mapimport.py and attached to the BF area. 'spawn_ids' = word index in the area struct -> new actor name (the word holds actor id + 9). Test setup: the new game's first area (Snake Way, 1:1) becomes Dr. Gero's Lab room 61 with Gevo and Android 16. 'doors' add rect objects (fn 0x08007387/0x080071A7, the same as Goku's House doors) whose action is script code. 'new_areas' are added to the relocated AreaEntry table (cloned from 'template'). Doors: 'warp': [world, area, x, y] = engine door (arrive at x, y); 'dir' = the way the player walks into it, 'face' = the way they face/walk on arrival (default = dir). Area ids 1:60-65 mirror LoG2's lab ids; LoG2 61 is BF 1:1. Every placement and door is checked in the emulator by tools/clipcheck.py.
